title: NASA indicative four-passenger, 50-mile urban eVTOL energy-reference case

reference_range.interpretation: NASA planning reference; whether this is route distance, mission distance, or a reserve-inclusive range must be resolved before sizing.

open_questions: Confirm whether four passengers are additional to the flight crew.
Define passenger and baggage payload mass and the corresponding centre-of-gravity envelope.
Resolve whether the 50-mile reference means route distance, radius, or reserve-inclusive mission range.
Choose the operating jurisdiction and an appropriate reserve, diversion, and landing policy.
Define route geometry, vertiport elevation, obstacle environment, and alternate landing sites.
Define temperature, wind, precipitation, density-altitude, and dispatch-weather design cases.
Set the energy-metering boundary and document all electrical auxiliaries and conversion losses.
Define turnaround, charging dwell, acoustic measurement geometry, and mission success criteria.

provenance.source_name: NASA Aerospace Battery Workshop — Next-Generation Solid-State Batteries for Aerospace Applications
provenance.source_claim: NASA workshop material lists an indicative 300 Wh/kg specific-energy requirement alongside a four-passenger, 50-mile urban eVTOL planning case. The mission card records the reference case only; it does not establish a qualified design requirement or certified aircraft performance.
